messages.content: Predict a recorded human decision in an anonymous dictator allocation task in Bosnia. The dictator has a fresh budget of 10 Bosnian Convertible Marks (KM) in each of two allocation rounds, and chooses an integer amount from 0 through 10 KM to SEND to the named recipient; the remaining 10 minus that amount is theirs to KEEP. The recipient is not in the room and has no accept/reject action. Money kept is taken home, and money sent is put in an opaque sealed envelope for a future participant of the indicated ethnicity. Each allocation is real money; both rounds count, with no randomly selected single round. The envelope procedure uses money and blank slips to conceal the split. In both waves the same-ethnicity round comes first, followed by a fresh-budget different-ethnicity round; the latter recipient ethnicity was randomly selected from the two other ethnic groups. This order was fixed. Participants are seated privately and may not communicate or inspect other answers. They may know their own earlier allocation, but do not learn money sent to them by others before these choices. Use the current recipient and participant attributes below. A null attribute means unavailable, not a category to infer. Output only the amount SENT in KM, an integer 0 through 10, without explanation.
